post.description:
Sends a 5-digit verification code to the provided phone number for registration purposes.

**Registration Flow:**
1. Call this endpoint with phone number
2. User receives OTP via SMS (5-digit code)
3. Call POST /auth/register/otp/verify with the OTP
4. Receive verificationToken in response
5. Use verificationToken to complete registration (customer or vendor)

**Business Rules:**
- OTP expires in 10 minutes
- OTP can be resent (resending resets the timer)
- Phone number must not already be registered
- Phone format: international format with country code (e.g., +201001001001)

**Auth Required:** No

example.summary: Send OTP for new phone number

200.description: OTP sent successfully. Code expires in 10 minutes.

400.description: Bad Request — validation error (invalid phone number format, invalid userType)

post.summary: Send OTP for registration

post.description:
Verifies the OTP sent to the user's phone and returns a verificationToken.

**Registration Flow:**
1. User receives OTP from POST /auth/register/otp/send
2. Call this endpoint with phone and OTP
3. Receive verificationToken (valid for 30 minutes)
4. Use verificationToken in POST /auth/register/customer/complete or /vendor/complete

**Business Rules:**
- OTP must match the one sent to the phone number
- OTP must not be expired (10-minute window)
- verificationToken is single-use and expires in 30 minutes
- After verification, user must complete registration within 30 minutes

**Auth Required:** No

200.description: Phone verified successfully. Use the verificationToken to complete registration.

400.description: Bad Request — validation error (invalid phone number format, invalid userType)

post.summary: Verify OTP for registration and get verification token

post.description:
Completes the customer registration process using the verificationToken obtained from OTP verification.

**Registration Flow:**
1. Send OTP (POST /auth/register/otp/send)
2. Verify OTP (POST /auth/register/otp/verify) → receive verificationToken
3. Call this endpoint with verificationToken, fullName, and password
4. Receive accessToken and refreshToken for authenticated requests

**Business Rules:**
- verificationToken must be valid and not expired (30-minute window)
- Password must be at least 6 characters
- Phone number must not already be registered
- After successful registration, user is automatically logged in

**Auth Required:** No

201.description: Customer registered successfully. User is automatically logged in.

400.description: Bad Request — validation error (password too short, missing required fields)

post.summary: Complete customer registration after OTP verification

post.description:
Completes the vendor registration process using the verificationToken obtained from OTP verification.

**Registration Flow:**
1. Send OTP (POST /auth/register/otp/send)
2. Verify OTP (POST /auth/register/otp/verify) → receive verificationToken
3. Call this endpoint with verificationToken, businessName, serviceCategoryId, and password
4. Vendor account is created in PENDING status (requires admin approval)
5. Receive accessToken and refreshToken for authenticated requests

**Business Rules:**
- verificationToken must be valid and not expired (30-minute window)
- Password must be at least 6 characters
- serviceCategoryId must be a valid, active service category UUID
- Vendor starts in PENDING status — cannot accept orders until admin approves
- Phone number must not already be registered

**Auth Required:** No

post.description:
Authenticates a user (customer, vendor, or operator) with phone number and password.

**Business Rules:**
- User must have verified phone number (isPhoneVerified = true)
- Returns accessToken (valid 1 hour) and refreshToken (valid 7 days)
- Role is included in JWT payload for authorization
- Failed login attempts are rate-limited

**Supported Roles:**
- customer: Can create orders, view their orders
- vendor: Can manage services, accept/complete orders, manage operators
- operator: Can view assigned orders, update location

**Auth Required:** No

200.description: Login successful. Use accessToken for authenticated requests.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid phone number or password

post.description:
Authenticates an admin user with phone number and password.

**Business Rules:**
- Admin accounts are created by Super Admin (POST /admins)
- Returns accessToken (valid 1 hour) and refreshToken (valid 7 days)
- Admin role and permissions are included in JWT payload
- Admin permissions determine access to specific admin endpoints
- Failed login attempts are rate-limited

**Admin Roles:**
- super_admin: Full access, can create/manage other admins
- admin: Can manage vendors, users, categories, car data (based on permissions)

**Auth Required:** No

403.description: Forbidden — maximum session limit reached. Please logout from other devices.

post.summary: Admin login with phone and password

post.description:
Refreshes an expired access token using a valid refresh token.

**Token Lifecycle:**
- accessToken: Valid for 1 hour — used for API requests
- refreshToken: Valid for 7 days — used to get new accessTokens
- When accessToken expires, call this endpoint with refreshToken
- Receive new accessToken and refreshToken (rotation)

**Business Rules:**
- refreshToken must be valid and not expired
- refreshToken must not be revoked (user logout revokes all refreshTokens)
- Old refreshToken is invalidated after use (token rotation)
- If refreshToken is invalid, user must login again

**Auth Required:** No

200.description: Token refreshed successfully. Use new accessToken for requests.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or expired refresh token

post.summary: Refresh access token

post.description:
Logs out the user and invalidates the provided refresh token.

**Business Rules:**
- Invalidates the specific refreshToken provided
- User must call this endpoint on app logout to invalidate session
- After logout, refreshToken cannot be used to get new accessTokens
- User must login again to get new tokens
- Does not invalidate other active sessions (other refreshTokens remain valid)

**Auth Required:** No

200.description: Logged out successfully. Refresh token has been invalidated.

patch.description:
Toggles the vendor's availability status to control whether they can receive new orders.

**Business Rules:**
- isAvailable = true: Vendor can receive new instant and scheduled orders
- isAvailable = false: Vendor cannot receive new orders (existing orders continue)
- Customers see isAvailable status on vendor profile to know if vendor is accepting orders
- Vendors should toggle this when they're busy, offline, or unable to serve
- Does not affect already accepted orders
- Vendors should set this to false when order queue is full

**Use Cases:**
- Toggle off when taking a break
- Toggle off when weather conditions are bad
- Toggle off when staff is unavailable
- Toggle on when ready to accept orders again

**Auth Required:** Yes — Bearer JWT (role: vendor)

patch.description:
Updates the maximum number of concurrent active orders the vendor can handle.

**Business Rules:**
- orderCapacity range: 1-50
- When active orders reach orderCapacity, vendor cannot receive new orders (even if isAvailable = true)
- Increasing capacity allows vendor to accept more simultaneous orders
- Decreasing capacity doesn't cancel existing orders, only prevents new ones until active count drops
- System prevents new orders when: activeOrders >= orderCapacity

**Recommended Capacities:**
- Solo operator: 1-2
- Small team (2-3 people): 3-5
- Medium team (4-6 people): 6-10
- Large team (7+ people): 10-50

**Auth Required:** Yes — Bearer JWT (role: vendor)

get.description:

**Slot Calculation Rules:**
- Slots are generated based on vendor's working hours for that day
- Excludes dates with schedule exceptions (blocked dates)
- Excludes slots that are already booked
- Considers service duration + buffer time
- Only returns slots that are in the future

**Response Format:**
- Array of time strings in HH:MM format (24-hour)
- Empty array means no slots available for that date

**Business Rules:**
- Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format
- Cannot book slots for past dates
- Vendor must be APPROVED status
- Service must not be archived

**Auth Required:** Yes — Bearer JWT (any role)

post.description:
Places a new service order for a vendor service. Only customers can create orders.

Supports both `application/json` and `multipart/form-data` content types.
For file uploads, use `multipart/form-data` with files named `customer_file_<key>` where `<key>` matches the `requiredCustomerFields` key of type `file`.

**Order Status Flow:**
`pending_acceptance` → `accepted` → `en_route` → `arrived` → `in_progress` → `completed`
                                                                                    ↘ `cancelled`

**Business Rules:**
- Vendor must have `isAvailable: true`
- Vendor must have capacity (active orders < `orderCapacity`)
- For scheduled orders: `scheduledAt` must be within vendor's available slots
- `orderCustomerAttributes` must match the vendor's `requiredCustomerFields`
- Rate limited: 5 orders per minute per user

**Auth Required:** Yes — Bearer JWT (role: customer)

400.description: Bad Request — vendor not available, scheduled time outside working hours, vendor at full capacity, service does not allow scheduling, service requires quotation, missing required attributes, unknown attributes, slot not available, or scheduled date must be in the future

409.description: Conflict — selected time slot is already booked (unique constraint violation)

503.description: Service Unavailable — vendor is not available, vendor is closed today, vendor is currently closed/busy, or scheduled time outside working hours

post.description:
Registers or updates an FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) token for the authenticated user.

**Token Registration Flow:**
1. Mobile app obtains FCM token from Firebase SDK
2. Call this endpoint with the token and platform
3. Server stores/updates the token for push notifications
4. Server sends push notifications to this token for relevant events

**Platform Values:**
- `ios`: iOS device (APNs via FCM)
- `android`: Android device (FCM)

**Business Rules:**
- If token doesn't exist: creates new record (returns 201)
- If token exists: updates platform and timestamp (returns 200)
- Token is linked to the authenticated user's ID
- One user can have multiple tokens (multiple devices)
- Rate limited: 5 requests per minute
- Used for: order status updates, vendor notifications, operator assignments

**Auth Required:** Yes — Bearer JWT (any role: customer, vendor, operator, admin)

- With status filter: returns only orders matching that status
- Use this to show different views (e.g., active orders vs history)

- Only returns orders assigned to this operator (assignedOperatorId matches)
- Orders are sorted by scheduledAt (upcoming first)

post.description:
Stores the operator's GPS coordinates on their active (accepted or in_progress) order.

**Use Cases:**
- Real-time tracking of operator location
- Customer can see operator approaching
- Vendor can monitor operator movements
- Location updates during travel to customer

**Business Rules:**
- Operator must have an active order (accepted or in_progress status)
- locationType indicates the context of the location update
- Updates are stored on the order for tracking purposes
- Latitude must be between -90 and 90
- Longitude must be between -180 and 180
- Multiple updates can be made on the same order
